source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Set up the testing environment
3. Determine the specific test record failing an advertised spec. It might fail one or more.
4. The ADRP should include documentation of all failing test records and their corresponding failed advertised specs.
5. The ADRP should cite or reference any external documentation for documents associated with the failing advertised specs.
6. Include a discussion of how the failing advertised spec is prevented.
7. All associated telemetry should be included as well.
8. Document the recommended actions to avoid recurrence for the next Rev.
9. Determine if there were any test record failures that were related to the failing spec test record.
10. If any test records were impacted, complete the same steps all over again.
11. If there are multiple test record failures, a table of values in the performance report is acceptable to describe the failure of each.
12. When a test record fails, all other test
